Depart 2027-01-20, return 2027-02-03

**WARNING: ALL figures below are SAMPLE DATA (source: sample-data, synthetic). They are illustrative planning numbers, not live availability, and nothing here is bookable.** Flights and lodging both came back as sample data.

## Flights (round trip, cabin returned: business on all offers; no cabin_note)
| Carrier | Departs LAX | Stops | Duration (min, as reported) | Per traveler | Total for 2 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northwind | 09:53 | 2 | 619 | $1,641.86 | $3,283.72 |
| Meridian Air | 10:46 | 1 | 509 | $1,743.53 | $3,487.06 |
| Anser Airways | 15:39 | 0 | 399 | $2,361.86 | $4,723.72 |
| Blue Corridor | 15:00 | 0 | 444 | $2,555.06 | $5,110.12 |

Notes: the sample durations are unrealistically short for LAX–SYD (real nonstops take about 14-15 hours), so treat them as illustrative. A flight leaving LAX on Jan 20 will really land in Sydney on Jan 22 local time because of the date line.

## Lodging, Sydney, 2 guests (all sample data, USD)
### Check-in 2027-01-20, check-out 2027-02-03 (14 nights, the dates as requested)
| Option | Type | Nightly | Total | Rating | Free cancellation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Budget hostel, private room | hostel | $128.75 | $1,802.50 | 7.8 | No |
| Quiet guesthouse | guesthouse | $159.25 | $2,229.50 | 9.1 | Yes |
| Business district hotel | hotel | $193.75 | $2,712.50 | 8.2 | No |
| Riverside apartment | apartment | $222.25 | $3,111.50 | 8.6 | Yes |
| Central boutique hotel | hotel | $254.75 | $3,566.50 | 8.9 | No |

### Alternate check-in 2027-01-21 (13 nights)
Hostel $1,744.73; guesthouse $2,119.91; business hotel $2,573.09; riverside apartment $2,948.27; boutique hotel $3,349.45. The cancellation flags are the same as above. The Jan 21 check-in is cheaper, but the flights would really arrive Jan 22, so a later check-in may fit better.

No `due_at_accommodation` amounts were reported on any stay.

## Comparison
- Best on price: Northwind, $3,283.72 for 2, with 2 stops and the longest travel time. Pair it with the hostel ($1,802.50) for about $5,086 in total.
- Best on convenience: Anser Airways nonstop, $4,723.72 for 2, departing mid-afternoon. It costs $1,440 more than Northwind. Blue Corridor is also nonstop but costs more, so Anser is the better nonstop value. Meridian Air (1 stop, $3,487.06) is a middle option.
- Lodging: the Quiet guesthouse is the best value. It has the highest rating (9.1) and free cancellation, and it costs $2,229.50.

- Tradeoff: the cheapest flight costs about $1,440 less but adds two stops and roughly 3.5 hours of sample travel time. Over a 14-night trip that matters more in business class, where rest is the reason for paying the premium.
